rationale: Both epic-merge gates are documented as an intentionally mirrored pair; fixing merge_epic_branch alone would introduce a silent cross-runner behavioral divergence for the same epic-completion scenario. Tied 8/12 on raw score; Consistency (3/3 vs 1/3) was the deciding dimension.
rule: Option B — change merge_epic_branch and ParallelOrchestrator._maybe_complete_epic together, not merge_epic_branch alone
alternatives_rejected: Option A — fix merge_epic_branch's all_done condition alone
